stem.text: The diagram shows a cell surface membrane.

stem.alt: Diagram of a cell surface membrane showing phospholipid bilayer, proteins, carbohydrate chains, and labels W, X, Y and Z.

stem.text: Which is a correct role for a labelled molecule?

A.text: W is involved in controlling membrane stability.

B.text: X is involved in active transport.

C.text: Y is involved in cell signalling.

D.text: Z is involved in diffusion of ions.
